caveats:
AI predictions. Cross-sensor pre and post plus post-cloud can inflate destroyed calls.
Coverage limited to the analyzed AOI. Field verification is the ground truth.

Model evaluated against 2,681 mapper-tagged OSM `destroyed:building` polygons (as of
2026-09-11): destroyed-class precision 0.80, recall 0.76, F1 0.78. Severe (major +
destroyed) recall 0.88.
name: hot_flood_npl_buildings_damage
notes:
Part of the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team response activation for the 26 August 2026
Bhote Koshi and Trishuli flash flood in Nepal.

AI-scored building damage per OpenStreetMap footprint across the upper Trishuli and Bhote
Koshi corridor, from Rasuwagadhi to the Narayani confluence. Post imagery is a 26-scene
Vantor open-data composite (2026-08-27 to 2026-09-08, roughly 0.4 m/px, about 9.8% cloud).
Pre imagery is ESRI World Imagery, served live from ESRI and not redistributed here.
Buildings combine standing (`building=*`) and mapper-tagged destroyed
(`destroyed:building=*`) OpenStreetMap features; 22,624 buildings scored.

Each feature carries `osm_id`, `osm_type`, `building`, `damage_class` (-1..3), a `damage`
label (`no-visible-damage`, `minor-damage`, `major-damage`, `destroyed`, `no-data`) and a
`damage_confidence`.

Evaluated and validated against 2,681 OSM mapper-tagged `destroyed:building` lifecycle
features (2026-09-11): destroyed precision 0.80, recall 0.76, F1 0.78; severe (major +
destroyed) recall 0.88. The reference layer is included in this dataset.

For the wider corridor context, see [Nepal Flood 2026 Flood Affected Area](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hot_flood_npl).

- Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/), Vantor open data, ESRI World Imagery
- Part of HOT disaster response exports on HDX by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)

Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) acts as a bridge between the traditional humanitarian responders and the OpenStreetMap Community. HOT works both remotely and physically in countries to assist the collection of geographic data, usage of that information and training others in OpenStreetMap.
